source_caption:
Rush Hour is an action-comedy starring Jackie Chan and Chris Tucker. It follows a disciplined Hong Kong detective and a loud, fast-talking LAPD cop who are forced to work together to rescue a kidnapped girl.

The movie is known for its perfect mix of martial arts action and comedy, especially the chemistry between the two leads. Its success led to sequels like Rush Hour 2 and Rush Hour 3, making it one of the most popular buddy-cop franchises.

source_details.title: Rush Hour
source_details.synopsis: Rush Hour is a 1998 American buddy cop action comedy film directed by Brett Ratner from a screenplay by Jim Kouf and Ross LaManna and a story by LaManna. It stars Jackie Chan, Chris Tucker, Tom Wilkinson, Chris Penn, and Elizabeth Peña. In the film, Hong Kong Police Force (HKPF) Chief Inspector Lee (Chan) and Los Angeles Police Department (LAPD) Detective James Carter (Tucker) are forced to work together to rescue a Chinese diplomat's abducted daughter. Development on Rush Hour began in 1995, after LaManna wrote a spec script, which was first initially sold to Hollywood Pictures with Ratner and Chan both attached to the project. The film was eventually shelved until being acquired by New Lin
